title: New Business Executive at SetSales
description:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can take on responsibility from day one? Do you want to be part of an ambitious, entrepreneurial team? And are you excited about building a successful career in sales?

About us

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

This is an opportunity to build exceptional sales skills while helping us grow some of the world's leading business conferences.

You’ll join our London team and receive the training, coaching and responsibility to accelerate your development from day one.

•
Training & Coaching: Ongoing feedback and support from our leadership team.

•
Uncapped earning potential . Competitive base salary plus an attractive commission structure where your results directly impact your earnings.

•
International exposure: Speak with senior executives, investors and business leaders from around the world and attend our international conferences.

•
Fast career progression: We promote internally and give high performers significant responsibility early in their careers.

•
25 days' holiday .

•
Great team culture: Regular team socials, lunches and events.

Your responsibilities

Your mission will be to drive revenue by selling delegate passes to senior professionals attending our international conferences.

You will:

•
Drive new business: Proactively reach out to prospective delegates and convert them into paying attendees.

•
Own your targets: Take responsibility for ambitious monthly revenue goals and work towards exceeding them.

•
Execute high-volume outreach: Make 50+ calls per day, generating qualified sales opportunities and proposals.

•
Manage your pipeline: Own prospects from first conversation through follow-up, proposal and close.

•
Become an expert: Build a strong understanding of our conferences, audiences and industries so you can sell with confidence.

What we expect from you

Most importantly, you want to sell. You enjoy speaking with people, working towards ambitious targets and the feeling of turning an opportunity into a closed deal.

We’re looking for someone who has:

•
At least 1 year of B2B sales experience , ideally involving outbound prospecting, new business or a high-volume sales environment.

•
Drive & ambition: You are highly motivated, competitive and want to perform at a high level.

•
Commercial mindset: You are energised by targets, revenue and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings.

•
Resilience: You are comfortable with outbound activity and have the persistence to keep going when you hear "no".

•
Strong communication skills: You are confident speaking with new people and can build rapport quickly.

•
Ownership: You take responsibility for your targets, pipeline and follow-ups.

•
Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback and continuously look for ways to improve.

We welcome applications from recent graduates and early-career professionals, provided you have at least one year of B2B sales experience and can demonstrate the drive, communication skills and competitive mindset needed to succeed in a high-performance sales environment.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday-Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London . Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Talent Growth and Inclusion Intern- Summer 2027
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Summer Internship  

Our Summer Internship is designed for students leading into their final year of university, who want to gain real life work experience in a fast past, exciting and professional environment.

As a Summer Intern, you will participate in onboarding with the UR team that will set you up for success in your role. You will also benefit from professional development sessions, networking, and social events provided by the Internship Program.

The program takes place from June - August 2027 (10-week program).

Your Role

As a Talent Growth & Inclusion intern, you'll own a meaningful piece of an enterprise-level Talent Management project - spanning career development, performance, learning, inclusion, or leadership development. You'll work directly with the Talent Growth & Inclusion team, People Partners, and subject matter experts. You'll be expected to ask good questions, form a point of view, and present it - not just execute a task list.

What you'll do

• Take a loosely defined problem and turn it into a clear plan: what you're solving, what you need to know, and how you'll get there.

• Research, synthesize, and structure complex information into something a busy executive can act on.

• Build presentation-ready deliverables - documents, frameworks, decks, or tools - that hold up without heavy editing.

• Communicate proactively: flag blockers early, surface what you've learned, and tell us when your thinking has changed.

• Present your work and recommendations to the team, and to People & Culture stakeholders.

What we're looking for

• Critical thinking. You don't stop at the first answer. You ask why, look for what's missing, and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendation - not just the recommendation.

• Creative problem solving. You're comfortable when there's no template. You generate options, weigh trade-offs, and try a different angle when the first one stalls.

• Communication, written and verbal. You write clearly and concisely for the reader in front of you. You speak up in meetings, ask the question you're not sure you should ask, and keep people informed without being chased.

• You own the outcome, not just the effort. You meet commitments, tell us early when you can't, incorporate feedback the first time, and check your own work before it reaches someone else's desk.

How we work with AI

We use AI at Veeam every day, and we want you to use it too. But we're specific about how.

AI is a tool for extending your thinking - pressure-testing an idea, accelerating research, drafting a starting point, checking your logic. It is not a substitute for it. Interns who thrive here use AI to get further, faster, and can still explain every choice in their work, defend it under questioning, and tell you what the model got wrong. Work that's been outsourced to a model shows immediately, and it doesn't meet our bar.

If you're curious about applying AI to make career, learning, and performance experiences more personalized and scalable, you'll have room to run with that here.

Requirements

• Rising junior or senior pursuing a bachelor's degree, or a graduate student, at an accredited college or university - studying Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, Psychology, Education, or a related field

• Strong interest in talent dev

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
Job Summary
The Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform builds and operates the foundational data
infrastructure that powers analytics, reporting, and operational workflows across the
organization. This role designs, develops, and maintains scalable batch and streaming pipelines,
curated data models, and platform services that enable internal teams-including Asset
Management, Finance, and Operations-to access reliable, well-governed data. The position
partners with Data Engineering, IT, and business stakeholders to translate platform
requirements into production-grade solutions with strong quality controls, observability, and
security. Core emphasis areas include: (1) data ingestion and integration-building robust
connectors and pipelines to land data from internal and third-party sources into the platform
with clear lineage and auditability; (2) data modeling and curation-designing dimensional and
domain-oriented models in Snowflake and PostgreSQL that support self-service analytics and
downstream applications; and (3) platform reliability and developer experience-establishing
standards, reusable frameworks, orchestration patterns, and monitoring to accelerate delivery
while maintaining operational excellence.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate end-to-end data pipelines (batch and near-real-time) that ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources into the enterprise data platform.

• Develop and maintain curated data models, marts, and shared datasets in Snowflake andPostgreSQL that meet performance, quality, and access-control requirements for multiple internal customers.

• Implement data quality frameworks including automated validation, schema enforcement, reconciliation checks, duplicate detection, and exception reporting with clear audit trails.

• Partner with domain teams (e.g., Asset Management, Finance, Operations) to understand data needs, define contracts and SLAs, and deliver platform capabilities that reduce bespoke engineering and manual effort.

• Build parameterized, reusable pipeline components and templates that standardize ingestion patterns, transformations, and deployment across the platform.

• Establish and maintain data lineage, metadata, and documentation so stakeholders can trace data from source to consumption with confidence.

• Collaborate with IT and security to implement role-based access controls, data masking, encryption, and compliance requirements across platform resources.

• Own pipeline orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, and alerting using workflow tools (e.g., Airflow) to ensure reliable, recoverable execution.

• Improve platform observability through logging, metrics, SLA monitoring, and incident response practices that minimize downtime and data freshness gaps.

• Support CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices for data platform assets, including version control, automated testing, and safe promotion across environments.

• Evaluate and integrate new platform technologies and patterns (e.g., streaming, CDC, data mesh principles) where they improve scalability, cost efficiency, or time-to-value.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to platform standards, code review practices, and technical design documentation.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering or platform engineering, preferably in a financial services or regulated industry (e.g., asset management, banking, insurance, fintech).

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with a track record of building production-quality data

• pipelines, transformations, and validation frameworks.

• Proficient at using AI-assisted development tools to design, build, and iterate on data pipelines while maintaining code quality, security, and governance standards.

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake and PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, cost optimization, and secure m

Remote | Contract (1099) | Part-Time, approximately 20 hours per week | November 1 to January 15

You will work under that direction and handle the configuration, testing, validation, and documentation of identity lifecycle and entitlement management workflows.

• Perform discovery of existing identity sources, target systems, and entitlement structures, and document findings and dependencies for the architect

• Provide input to the architect on governance design and tool configuration decisions

• Configure identity lifecycle workflows covering joiner, mover, and leaver events

• Build and configure entitlement management structures including access packages, catalogs, and approval policies

• Configure access reviews and certification campaigns, including scope, reviewer assignment, and remediation handling

• Configure Conditional Access policies aligned to lifecycle states and access risk

• Run test cycles, then validate provisioning and deprovisioning behavior across users, groups, and service accounts

Our R&D team builds cutting-edge visual intelligence for the global retail industry, analyzing complex in-store scenes and dense shelf environments across major markets worldwide. We combine deep learning, modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and generative AI to extract real-time understanding from retail imagery at massive scale.
Recently, we expanded into Augmented Reality (AR) - merging machine learning, 2D/3D geometry, and computer graphics to deliver interactive, spatial experiences directly onto edge devices. As an AI Software Engineer on this team, you will focus on solving non-trivial algorithmic challenges, developing visual and multimodal architectures, and shipping production-grade solutions deployed across thousands of stores globally. Crucially, this is an engineering-first role: roughly 80% of your time will be spent writing high-quality, fully tested production code rather than conducting pure academic research.

FORM powers the world’s two billion mobile workers as they change companies and industries for good, with mobile technology that improves execution from the frontline. FORM solutions include the AI-enabled task management platform GoSpotCheck, Trax ’s image recognition technology, and FORM OpX, all of which activate and connect teams in the field - with leaders, missions, and each other - so they can deliver success in the enterprise. •
AR & Spatial Solutions: Design and implement features bridging computer vision and computer graphics, applying 2D/3D geometric principles to power interactive Augmented Reality workflows.

•
Edge & On-Device Deployment: Profile, optimize, and quantize non-trivial algorithms for latency- and memory-constrained edge hardware (e.g., mobile devices and embedded systems).

•
VLM & Generative AI Innovation: Work hands-on with multimodal LLMs, VLMs, and advanced prompting techniques to create next-generation automated recognition tools.

•
Algorithm Refinement & Scaling: Enhance and optimize existing algorithms to ensure high efficiency, robustness against varying store conditions, and global scalability through rigorous software architecture.

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying Machine Learning and Deep Learning models in production or applied R&D environments.

•
Multimodal & Generative AI: Practical experience working with modern LLMs/VLMs and prompt engineering techniques.

•
Core Tech Stack: High proficiency in Python, deep learning frameworks (Keras, Tensorflow, Jax preferred), and standard software development tools.

•
Research-to-Product Mindset: Strong problem-solving ability to take complex academic/R&D concepts and adapt them into robust, non-trivial, and highly maintainable production features.

•
Communication: Comfortable collaborating daily in English, both written and verbal, in a distributed international team.

•
Software Engineering Best Practices: Strong commitment to writing clean code, unit/integration tests, and using Git. Experience working within a structured team environment (code reviews, Jira, CI/CD pipelines).

About Local Progress and Local Progress Impact Lab

Local Progress and the Local Progress Impact Lab work collectively to advance a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of government. Local Progress (LP) is a movement of more than 1,800 local elected officials advancing a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of local government. The Local Progress Impact Lab (the Impact Lab) brings together local leaders, partners, and experts to build the knowledge, skills, and leadership needed to advance racial and economic justice at the local level.

CSQ427R89

Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE - Communications, Media, Entertainment, & Gaming

About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

• Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

• Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning

Record Keeping:

• Document all inspections, maintenance, and repair work.

As a Supervisor on the power generation team, you will lead the technicians who operate, maintain, and repair on-site generation that powers SpaceXAI’s high-density AI supercomputing facilities. title: Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)
We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

title: Software Engineer – Query Engines
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Backend Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations use data. Our Software Engineers are involved throughout the product lifecycle, from idea generation, design, prototyping, and production delivery. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical teammates to understand our customers' problems and build products that solve them. We encourage movement across teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different technologies and aspects of each product. Engineers work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop, becoming a strong technical contributor and engineering leader.
 
Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with other engineers to architect a new system that enables a novel workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency operational outcomes.
 
Our Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability.
 
We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.
 
Frontline
 
Foundry Software Engineers may be offered the opportunity to Frontline, an exclusive program unlike any other. This unique, short-term assignment involves being embedded with customers, allowing you to work directly with users and gain firsthand insight into how our products are used and the challenges our customers face. Unlike traditional engineering roles, Frontline immerses you in complex, ambiguous problems, empowering you to deliver impactful solutions across some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
Some of our most successful products were built on the factory floor, addressing real-world problems for the world's most important institutions. These products were developed by some of our most successful product engineers, who began their careers in roles aligned with Frontline responsibilities, gaining a deep understanding of both our technology and our customers.
 
Frontliners operate across a broad spectrum of responsibilities, much like a startup CTO. They work in small teams to own the end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects. This spectrum ranges from discussing architecture and building custom web apps to conducting workshops with users and strategizing with customer executives. No two days are alike, as each day is diverse and impactful. By witnessing how customers engage with Foundry and experiencing these pain points firsthand, you’ll gain unique insights that feed directly back into our development process, helping to refine and enhance our products.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promo

title: Senior Meta Designer - Unannouced Project

description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

AT ALMEDIA, YOU’LL:

- Own way more, way earlier - you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

- Push harder, get further - this isn’t a 9-5. We highly reward intensity.

- Join a rare environment - you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

- Fully present - we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

GROWTH MANAGER (BERLIN)

Salary Range: €55K - €75K • Offers Bonus

AT A GLANCE

You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 🎯

- Own a book of 5-15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

- Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

- Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

- Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

- Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

- Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

WHAT YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE

- Days 1-30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

- Days 31-60: Take over a full book of 5-10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

- Days 61-90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

- Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 💡

- You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

- You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

- You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

title: Channel Account Manager, East
description:
Description
The Channel Account Manager will be responsible for managing and growing our channel partner ecosystem in the Eastern United States. This role will involve developing and nurturing relationships with existing partners, identifying new partners, and driving joint sales and marketing initiatives to expand Reco .ai’s footprint in the region. You will work closely with our sales, marketing, and technical teams to ensure our partners are well-equipped to sell and deliver Reco .ai’s AI solutions to their customers.
Responsibilities

•
Partner Relationship Management: Build, maintain and grow strong relationships with key channel partners (resellers, distributors, consultants, and system integrators) across the West + Central regions.

•
Sales Enablement Collaborate with sales and technical teams to equip partners with the tools, training, and resources needed to sell Reco .ai’s solutions effectively. Provide product demos, sales collateral, and technical training sessions.

•
Revenue Growth: Develop and implement joint sales plans with partners to drive revenue. Monitor and support partners to ensure sales targets are met and exceeded. Track performance, forecast sales, and report on channel KPIs.

•
Lead Generation & Opportunity Development: Work with the marketing team to generate and qualify leads for channel partners. Identify new business opportunities within the channel and align partners with these opportunities.

•
Strategic Account Management: Oversee the end-to-end process for key partner accounts, ensuring smooth deal closure, customer onboarding, and post-sales support. Act as the escalation point for major issues during the sales process.

•
Market Intelligence: Monitor and report on competitor activity, industry trends, and emerging market opportunities. Stay informed about customer needs and technology trends to keep Reco .ai’s solutions competitive.

•
Collaboration & Coordination: Serve as the primary liaison between Reco .ai and its channel partners. Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure strong partner engagement.

•
Partner Training & Development: Organize and participate in partner onboarding sessions, certification programs, and regular training updates. Keep partners engaged and well-informed on product developments and best practices.

Requirements

•
Experience: 5+ years of experience in channel sales, account management, or business development, with a strong understanding of the software and/or AI industry. Proven track record of successfully managing and growing channel partnerships. Familiarity with sales processes, forecasting, and performance tracking in a partner environment.

•
Domain Expertise: A strong understanding of the cybersecurity ecosystem and relevant channel partners is required. Relevant experience recruiting, nurturing, growing, and maintaining Security Channel Partnerships.

•
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels. Ability to work independently and take initiative while collaborating in a team environment. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Deep knowledge of the AI and/or SaaS space is a plus.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

•
Travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% within the assigned territory

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Stuttgart
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Statistician Network Coordinator
description:

Join a central Ops team that keeps Genius running smoothly - empowering our teams to focus on what they do best: driving the business forward.

The Role

Genius Sports relies on a strong network of statisticians to deliver accurate, live sports data. In this role, you will lead that network across your region. You will make sure coverage runs smoothly, data quality stays high, and procedures are followed. You will plan resources, support the team, and keep everyone informed. Your work helps us deliver reliable coverage for the sports and clients we serve.

Key responsibilities

• Deliver overall network performance against agreed KPIs, including coverage, data quality, and compliance.

• Own resource and capacity planning for the statistician network, and support recruitment and onboarding when needed.

• Make sure statisticians are available for agreed dates, and flag any obstacles or challenges early.

• Monitor match scheduling and applications, and give timely support to keep coverage on track.

• Manage budget compliance for travel, match tickets, and other statistician expenses.

• Keep statisticians up to date on new procedures and policies, run workshops when needed, and gather feedback.

• Oversee accreditation and scout spotting activities, and support operations stakeholders and client meetings as required.

What you'll bring

• Excellent command of English and strong verbal communication skills.

• Good resource management and planning skills.

• A methodical, analytical approach to problem solving.

• The ability to stay efficient and calm under pressure, with flexibility around your working schedule.

• Strong data management skills and good MS Office competence.

• A self-motivated, organised, and results-oriented approach.

• Solid knowledge of football, basketball, volleyball, and a range of other sports.

It'll be a bonus if you know

• Power BI.

One team, being brave, driving change

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

title: Design Lead
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We are hiring a design lead: a player-coach for someone who still loves to design while also having a passion to make other designers better.

This role sit within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

As a player-coach, you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.

• Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. Making it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.

• Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear

• Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.

• Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.

• Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.

• Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

• Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.

• Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of product design experience with 2+ years of management experience

• Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support senior designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user centered craft.

• Experience building and scaling design systems.

• AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.

• Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces

title: Firmware Validation Technician II (Onsite)
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will be part of a high-impact engineering team that develops embedded software for Axon devices, ensuring critical evidence is captured during mission-essential moments for our customers. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented software and firmware engineers and contribute to the creation of next-generation public safety products, including body-worn cameras, in-car audio-video systems, TASERs, wireless microphones, and more.

As a Firmware Validation Engineer I, you are a key quality voice for one or more Axon products, partnering with firmware, software, and hardware engineering to ship products customers can trust. You'll own testing for your product area with increasing independence, contribute to departmental testing standards, and help leadership make informed calls on coverage, bug severity, and release risk. Your work directly shapes product quality, customer trust, and release timelines.

Location: Scottsdale, AZ
Reports to: Software Engineering Manager
Direct Reports: N/A

What You'll Do:

• Own execution of release regression (manual and automated), exploratory testing, as well as impacted areas for individual new features, scoping coverage to risk and release timelines.

• Design and maintain the test strategy for assigned products/domains: test case creation and prioritization, and traceability from requirements (PRD/Jira) through to test cases in a test management system (e.g., Zephyr Scale).

• Partner with engineering under the shift-left model: review dev-authored test plans and acceptance tests, flag coverage gaps, and own the testing that engineering can't do alone (regression, exploratory, and specialized/environmental/vehicle testing).

• Investigate and document defects; represent QA in bug triage, pushing back on premature “won’t fix” calls with reproducible evidence and customer-impact data.

• Lead release-readiness reporting including feature quality reports, test execution status, and production-vs-staging escape analysis to inform go/no-go decisions.

• Identify and drive test tooling and process improvements (dashboards for regression/performance monitoring, new test-equipment integrations, AI-assisted test case generation) to increase coverage and efficiency.

• Coordinate with Engineering, PM/TPM, and hardware/RF labs to resolve scheduling, access, and documentation gaps that block testing.

• Manage multiple concurrent test cycles and releases with minimal oversight, setting priorities across competing deadlines.

What You Bring

• 3+ years in software, firmware, or hardware quality assurance / validation engineering, ideally on complex, multi-component products.

• Experience with embedded or connected-device products (firmware and hardware-software integration).

• Hands-on experience with test case design, test execution, and automated testing methodologies.

• Working experience within a test management and requirements-traceability practice, using Jira, Zephyr Scale (or equivalent), and log analysis tools (e.g., Splunk).

• Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python or similar) and CI/CD-integrated test frameworks.

• Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Familiarity with hardware and environmental test methods: RF, GPS/GNSS, environmental chambers, and connectivity (LTE/Wi-Fi) testing is preferred.

title: Program Manager, Safeguards Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. Within Safeguards, our Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence teams work as one org: Policy Design defines what is and isn't allowed across harm areas, Enforcement detects and acts on violations, and Threat Intelligence investigates sophisticated misuse and emerging threats.

That work runs across a lot of teams and moves fast. A single decision can touch model training, detection systems, product launches, legal review, and external communications. As the org's program manager, you'll keep all of it moving: tracking the portfolio across all three teams, running the processes that connect their work to each other and to the rest of the company, and making sure the right people are aligned before decisions land.

Your work will include the operating rhythm (planning, priorities, status, and decision tracking), launch and release readiness across policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence workstreams, and the processes that support how we share our work externally, including blog posts, threat reports, and other publications. You'll work closely with the org's leadership to spot risks early, clear blockers, and keep everyone pointed in the same direction.

This role is a good fit for someone who brings structure to ambiguous, fast-moving work without adding overhead, and who can earn the trust of policy experts, researchers, and engineers alike.

Important context for this role: some of the work may involve exposure to explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. It also may require late nights or weekend work.

Key responsibilities

•
Own cross-functional program management for the Policy Design, Enforcement and Threat Intel teams, keeping workstreams across harm areas on track and visible to leadership

•
Run the team's operating rhythm: quarterly planning, priority setting, status tracking, and a clear record of decisions, who made them, and why

•
Coordinate policy work with partner teams across research, product, engineering, legal, and communications, so dependencies are surfaced early and nothing lands on a partner as a surprise

•
Drive readiness for policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence work tied to model launches and product releases, including timelines, reviews, and sign-offs

•
Own the process for the org's external publications, including blog posts and threat reports, from idea through drafting, review, approvals, and publication

•
Identify risks, blockers, and resourcing gaps across the portfolio, and escalate them with a proposed path forward

•
Build lightweight processes and tools that make the team faster, and retire the ones that stop earning their keep

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience running cross-functional programs in a fast-moving technical environment, with a track record of shipping on time across teams you don't manage

•
Ability to bring structure to ambiguous work: breaking big goals into plans, owners, and milestones, and keeping them current as priorities shift

•
Strong written communication, including clear status updates, decision records, and summaries for executive audiences

•
Experience managing review and approval processes with multiple stakeholders, such as publications, launches, or policy releases

•
Judgment about when a process helps and when it's overhead, and a bias toward the lightest process that works

•
Comfort working on sensitive topics and holding high standards for confidentiality

Revamp is seeking a 3D Electrical Design Engineer III to lead the development and coordination of 3D models for utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and solar photovoltaic (PV) projects. The models you produce become the drawings construction teams use, so accuracy, constructability, and sound technical judgment directly support safe, timely project delivery.

In this role, you will independently lead significant portions of complex projects and coordinate several assignments at once. You will formulate and solve multidisciplinary layout challenges, review deliverables, mentor designers, and represent 3D design work in client and project meetings. Working with civil, structural, and electrical engineers. And construction stakeholders, you will help Revamp deliver purpose-built, impact driven designs that advance utility-scale renewable generation.

Core technical & functional responsibilities

• Identify technical risks, coordination conflicts, and schedule impacts early, and recommend a path to project leadership.

• Review vendor- and client-supplied models before incorporation, and document discrepancies for resolution.

• Coordinate designers assigned to project deliverables and align their work with project schedules and priorities.

Collaboration & communication

• Coordinate model interfaces and constructability with civil, structural, electrical engineers, and construction stakeholders.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer who enjoys solving problems and designing, building and scaling robust services and solutions. You’ll be working to deliver our product roadmap, choosing technologies, evaluating tradeoffs, and seeing your work through all the way to production.

At what3words, we’re proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You’ll work in technologies such as Spring, Redis, FastAPI, Docker, MySQL among many others.

This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative and ambitious team, at one of the most exciting times in this company’s life.

Essential Skills:

- Java Proficiency: Excellent Java programming skills, with significant experience in the Spring ecosystem.

- Database Proficiency: Commercial experience working with SQL & DB schema design.

- Ownership: Work autonomously, own features end-to-end, collaborate directly with PMs, QA, and other engineers.

- Distributed Systems: Experience designing and evolving microservices, including service boundaries, API contracts, and resilience when dependencies fail.

- Cloud and Containers: Hands-on experience running services with Docker and Kubernetes in AWS or a similar cloud environment.

- Reliability and Performance: Ability to diagnose production issues, improve observability, and make sound trade-offs around latency, scalability, and availability.

- Technical Leadership: Ability to set technical direction, make pragmatic architecture decisions, and raise engineering standards across teams.

- Soft Skills: Excellent communication in spoken and written English, paired with a product mindset and rigorous attention to detail.

Extra credit if you have:

- Experience working with Python, FastAPI and LLM APIs.

- Experience working with Voice AI Models.

- Experience with Agentic AI workflows for software development.

This role is an excellent growth opportunity for the ideal candidate to develop their experience and career so if you feel you meet most of the requirements and our mission resonates with you, please do apply.

The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office. While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work with your main office timezone).

Diversity & Inclusion

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to equality and inclusivity in our hiring processes and company culture.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits to all permanent employees of what3words:

- Competitive salary

- Flexible working

- 6 week remote working (work from anywhere) policy

- 25 days holiday: plus the option to buy more!

- Share options

- Private health insurance

 As we continue to expand our operations across India, one of the fastest-growing bus markets in the world, we are looking for a proactive & detail-oriented Traffic Control Executive for our Bangalore location who will help us keep our services running smoothly, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success.

This is a real-time operations role, where you will be responsible for overseeing live bus operations, ensuring seamless coordination between drivers, hosts, and internal teams, and managing crisis situations calmly in a fast-paced environment. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of Flix's services, including real-time monitoring, issue resolution, and cross-team coordination!

• Communicate with drivers and hosts via calls and messages to ensure smooth, on-time operations.

• Track and manage operational issues through Salesforce tickets, ensuring timely resolution.

• Handle crisis situations swiftly and decisively to minimize disruption to passengers and partners.

• Coordinate with Operations, Customer Support, and Global teams for end-to-end issue resolution.

• Maintain discipline, flexibility, and teamwork while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Basic Excel proficiency; experience with Salesforce is a strong plus.

• You are fluent in Telugu and English. Additional South Indian languages and Hindi are a plus.

• You are communicative, proactive, detail-oriented, and a dependable team player.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up.

Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, real-time issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Staff Technical Program Manager - AppEx
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a hybrid role based in our Menlo Park or Bellevue office. You will split your time between working on-site with your engineering, product, and leadership partners and working remotely, giving you dedicated in-person time for planning, alignment, and the high-stakes conversations where being in the room matters.

AS A STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Define and own the program strategy for AppEx's highest-impact initiatives, spanning application surfaces, developer tooling, AI-powered experiences, and the underlying platform, from initial framing through launch and adoption

- Lead programs that cross AppEx sub-orgs (Applications, Notebooks, Native Apps, Drivers, AIML, Developer Platform) and extend into partner organizations across Snowflake, driving alignment where no single team owns the outcome

- Partner with Directors, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Principal Engineers to shape multi-quarter roadmaps, make tradeoff decisions explicit, and build execution plans that hold up under real-world complexity

- Drive cross-org decisions on shared APIs, integration points, and developer-facing launches that touch multiple Snowflake product surfaces

- Diagnose systemic friction in how AppEx plans and delivers, and design the operating mechanisms, including AI-assisted workflows, that improve engineering velocity and predictability across the org

- Represent AppEx programs to executive leadership with clear, data-backed narratives, recommendations, and escalations that drive decisions

- Raise the bar for technical program management across AppEx by mentoring other TPMs and establishing practices the wider organization adopts

OUR IDEAL STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 8+ years of technical program management experience, ideally at a cloud software company, with a track record of owning complex, multi-team programs end to end

- Experience leading programs at organization-wide scope, where success depended on aligning several teams with competing priorities and no shared reporting line

- Deep familiarity with developer-facing products or platform engineering, and an understanding of what it takes to build great developer experiences and ship them at scale

- Strong technical depth: you work directly with engineers and architects, go deep on system design and dependencies when needed, and keep execution on track

- A proven ability to influence without authority across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-to-Market

- Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining structure and direction where none exists and making progress before all the answers are clear

- Excellent written and verbal communication, effective with engineers, executive stakeholders, and everyone in between

- Experience with modern cloud-native software development, including CI/CD, release management, and API-first development

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI products, such as LLM-powered features, agentic applications, or AI developer tooling, including the evaluation, quality, and launch-readiness challenges unique to them

- Working familiarity with GenAI

Unser Trainingsequipment

- Flexibilität: Profitiere von viel Flexibilität, z. B. indem Du Dir die Arbeit frei einteilst, aus dem Home Office arbeitest und 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr genießt

title: Distinguished Software Architect
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About The Role

Wayve is building the next generation of embodied AI for autonomous driving. As we move from developing our core technology to deploying it across multiple vehicle platforms, OEM programmes and Robotaxi applications, the complexity of our software systems is growing significantly.

We’re looking for a Distinguished Software Architect to help define how our software architecture evolves through this next phase of scale.

This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role, working across our onboard software, AI, simulation, training and inference, product engineering and Robotaxi teams. You’ll work alongside some of our most senior technical and engineering leaders to ensure that the systems we build today can scale across the products and platforms we need tomorrow.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll operate across engineering organisations rather than within a single team, developing a deep understanding of how our software systems fit together and where architectural decisions in one area impact another.

You’ll work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders to identify architectural challenges, shape technical direction and lead major changes that span multiple teams.

You’ll act as a trusted technical partner on some of our hardest engineering decisions, helping teams navigate trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and the long-term health and scalability of the overall system.

A significant part of the role will be leading through technical credibility and influence, creating alignment across teams and helping raise the bar for software design and engineering practices across Wayve.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Defining architectural direction across Wayve’s software ecosystem as we scale across an increasing number of vehicle platforms and products.

- Creating clear software boundaries, interfaces and abstractions that allow teams to develop quickly without introducing unnecessary fragmentation.

- Leading large architectural changes that span multiple engineering organisations.

- Improving how software is developed, integrated, tested and deployed across different vehicle platforms and programmes.

- Working across onboard software, AI, simulation, training and inference, product engineering and Robotaxi systems.

- Helping shape the development platforms and engineering systems that underpin how Wayve builds software at scale.

- Partnering with teams working with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to ensure our architecture can support different production environments and integrations.

- Acting as a technical decision-maker and tiebreaker on complex architectural decisions.

- Helping establish a strong engineering and design culture for building large-scale, safety-critical software systems.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You’ve operated as a Principal, Distinguished or equivalent senior individual contributor and have shaped the architecture of large, complex software systems.

- You have a track record of leading significant technical or architectural change across multiple teams or engineering organisations.

- You’re an exceptional systems thinker who can understand a broad technical landscape while still going deep where necessary.

- You’ve built or evolved software platforms that needed to operate reliably across significant scale and complexity.

- You’re comfortable making difficult technical trade-offs and can distinguish between what is right for an individual team and what is right for the broader system.

- You can influence senior engineers and engineering leaders through technical credibility rather than organisational authority.

• Des missions en adéquation avec leur expertise sectorielle

• Le soutien d'un cabinet de conseil ISO mondialement reconnu
